description: This file defines a REST API endpoint for user authentication within an ASP.NET Core web application, handling login requests, interacting with the identity system, and generating authentication tokens.

classes.name: AuthenticateEndpoint
classes.description: An API endpoint class for authenticating users, inheriting from Ardalis.ApiEndpoints.EndpointBaseAsync, managing login requests and token issuance.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Handles the login request asynchronously, performing password verification and generating a JWT token if successful.
